      WELCOME TO PHIN COFFEE HOI AN

      Since 2017, Phin Coffee Hoi An has grown from a small hidden café in the Ancient Town into one of Hoi An’s most loved coffee and restaurant destinations.

      Today, we roast our own coffee and welcome guests across our cafés and restaurants in Hoi An, serving specialty Vietnamese coffee, breakfast, brunch, and locally inspired food.

      Beyond our cafés, we share Vietnamese coffee culture through hands-on coffee classes, our own roastery, and genuine local experiences.

      Whether you’re looking for a restaurant in Hoi An, a great breakfast, specialty coffee, or a memorable local activity during your visit, Phin offers an authentic taste of Hoi An.

      Discover our story

      VIETNAMESE FOOD & DINING IN HOI AN

      Coffee is where our story began, but good food has become an equally important part of the Phin experience.

      At Phin Coffee Restaurant in Hoi An Old Town and Phin Lounge An Bang, we serve breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner, with a menu bringing together authentic Vietnamese flavours, Hoi An favourites and creative fusion dishes. Stay for a Vietnamese coffee, fresh juice, wine or one of our house cocktails.

      For a lighter daytime experience, Phin Brunch focuses on breakfast and brunch, alongside specialty coffee and fresh juices.

      Whether you’re starting your morning with us or settling in for dinner and drinks, each Phin location brings together good food, Vietnamese coffee and relaxed Hoi An hospitality.

      VIETNAMESE COFFEE CLASSES IN HOI AN

      Discover Vietnam’s Coffee Culture Through Our Three Unique Classes

      Experience authentic Vietnamese coffee traditions with our hands-on coffee classes in Hoi An.

      From an easy introduction to Vietnamese favourites such as egg coffee and salted coffee, to an in-depth master class and hands-on coffee roasting, choose the experience that suits your interest and time.

      EXPLORE COFFEE CLASSES

      LOCAL TOURS & EXPERIENCES IN HOI AN

      Discover Hoi An Beyond the Usual Tourist Routes

      Before opening Phin Coffee, we spent many years working as professional tour leaders throughout Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

      Drawing on more than two decades of experience in tourism and hospitality, we’ve created a small collection of local Hoi An experiences focused on food, coffee, cycling and everyday life.

      Explore Hoi An with the same local knowledge and personal hospitality that we bring to Phin every day.
